# Zudo Works

> Zudo Works is a software company that builds Zoho Creator applications, implements and customises Zoho CRM, writes Deluge scripts and API integrations, and develops custom business software. We work remotely with businesses in the United States, United Kingdom, Australia, New Zealand and India.

## Company facts
- Name: Zudo Works
- Legal entity: SVP Software and Global Solutions Corporation (private limited company registered in India, CIN U62011TN2026PTC197823)
- Registered office: Flat no.2, Plot no.1051, I-Block, 35th Street, 18th Main Road, Anna Nagar, Chennai 600040, India
- Email: admin@zudoworks.com
- Phone: +91 63854 35382
- Website: https://zudoworks.com/
- Track record: 20+ projects delivered by our team for 10+ clients; hands-on experience across 20+ Zoho products
- Zoho partner status: application in progress (Zudo Works is not yet an approved Zoho Partner)

## People
- Arunkumar V, Chief Technology Officer. Winner of the Zoho Partner Hackathon 2025 (as a developer) and holder of Zoho's Master of Creator certificate. LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/arunkumar-v-5509aa1aa/

## Services
- Zoho Creator development: custom applications, data models, portals, dashboards and Deluge workflows.
- Zoho CRM implementation and customisation: custom modules, blueprints, automation, data migration and training.
- Deluge development: functions, scheduled jobs, custom buttons and API calls across Zoho CRM, Creator and Books.
- Zoho integrations: Zoho REST APIs, webhooks, Zoho Flow and custom middleware connecting Zoho to accounting, e-commerce, payment and in-house systems.
- Zoho Books, Inventory, Desk, Analytics, Projects, People and Zoho One implementation.
- Custom software development: web applications, internal tools and dashboards when Zoho alone isn't the right fit.
- Business process automation and ongoing support and maintenance retainers.

## How we work
1. Discovery call to understand the process, systems and goals.
2. Solution design: data model, automations, integrations and user roles.
3. Build and integration, with testing and data-migration trial runs.
4. Go-live, training for administrators and end users, and documentation.
5. Optional monthly support retainer.

Typical timelines: most focused Zoho CRM or Zoho Creator projects take 2 to 8 weeks; multi-app rollouts with several integrations usually take 8 to 16 weeks. Timelines are confirmed in writing after a discovery call.
